basic_details.short_information: This recruitment is held under the "Chhattisgarh Police Special Executive Force (Bastar Fighters), Fighter Constable Service Recruitment (Recruitment and Conditions of Service) Rules 2026". These rules were notified by the Government of Chhattisgarh, Home (Police) Department, through notification No. ESTB-1/762/2025-HOME SECTION dated 31.08.2026. Applications opened on 2 November 2026. The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.details: As on 01.01.2026, candidates must be not less than 18 years and not more than 28 years of age. | Relaxations for government employees apply to candidates who are, or have been, employees of the Chhattisgarh Government and have not been declared unfit for government service. The 36-year limit for holders of temporary posts also applies to contingency-paid employees, work-charged employees and employees working under a project implementation committee. For retrenched government servants, temporary service counts even if it was done in more than one spell. All age relaxations are subject to the guidelines of the Chhattisgarh State Government.

qualification.education_qualification: 10th pass from a school in Chhattisgarh/Madhya Pradesh (5th pass for certain groups)
qualification.details: Scheduled Tribe candidates are eligible even with a 5th class pass. Candidates of all categories may also apply with a 5th class pass if they belong to either of these groups: Naxal-victim families in the state. Families living in relief camps in Naxal-affected areas. Candidates must hold the prescribed qualification on the last date of application. Applicants are responsible for attaching their educational qualification certificates to the form. Only local residents of Bastar district may apply. | Candidates of all categories must have a chest expansion of at least 5 cm. Women candidates are exempt from the chest requirement. The selection committee's decision on height and chest measurement is final. Third gender candidates must submit a certificate: If the certificate states male, the standards for men apply. If the certificate states female, the standards for women apply. | The candidate must not be physically disabled. The candidate must not have knock-knee or flat-foot. This condition is compulsory for all posts. All candidates must be medically fit. The competent officer will decide on candidates found unfit for these reasons after examining them personally. The officer may consult the District Chief Medical Officer if needed. The candidate must not have any eye disease and must be able to distinguish the main colours. | Candidates should check the full recruitment rules on the official websites for any further eligibility conditions.

salary_details.pay_scale: Level-4 of the pay matrix, plus allowances
salary_details.details: The notice does not print a rupee amount for Level-4. The State Government and Police Headquarters, Nava Raipur, may change the pay scale from time to time.

Selection is carried out in several stages

The test has five events
each worth 20 marks
for a total of 100 marks:
Long jump High jump Shot put 100 metre race 800 metre race
Rules for the test:
Candidates get only one chance in each event. Taking part in all events is compulsory. Unreserved candidates must score 60% of the 100 marks. SC
ST and OBC candidates must score 50% of the 100 marks. A candidate who is not satisfied with the assessment may appeal to the selection committee. The appeal will be decided immediately
and the committee's decision is final.
The interview carries a maximum of 20 marks. Up to 3 times the number of advertised posts will be called for the interview. All candidates with the same cut-off marks will be included.
A maximum of 30 bonus marks may be awarded:
Candidates must hold the certificates for bonus marks on the last date of application.
The final merit list will be prepared from the total of the marks obtained in the PET
the written examination and the interview
plus any bonus marks earned.

exam_pattern.details: Up to 15 times the number of advertised posts will be called for the written examination. All candidates with the same cut-off marks will be eligible to appear.

how_to_apply: There is no online application. Candidates must submit a paper form offline, by hand or by registered post.

Get the prescribed application form. A sample is attached to the notice. The form, physical standards, physical test, written exam and other details are also displayed on the notice boards of all police stations, police outposts and SDOP offices in Bastar district, and of the Superintendent of Police office.
Fill in the form yourself, in clear handwriting. The form is addressed to the Superintendent of Police, District Bastar, Jagdalpur.
Paste a recent passport-size photograph that is not older than 3 months.
Attach the certificates listed below and write their details and number in the enclosure list.
Sign the form and the declaration.

Submit the form on working days during office hours at one of these offices: Reserve Centre (Rakshit Kendra), Jagdalpur, District Bastar Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Keshloor (Parpa) Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Lohandiguda Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Bhanpuri
Reserve Centre (Rakshit Kendra), Jagdalpur, District Bastar
Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Keshloor (Parpa)
Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Lohandiguda

Alternatively, send the form only by registered Indian Post to: Office of the Superintendent of Police, Jagdalpur, District Bastar, PIN 494001. Postal applications must reach the office by 12.12.2026 within office hours. Applications received after that will not be accepted.
If you apply by post, keep the registered post receipt and bring it with you on the date fixed for recruitment. Doing so is compulsory.
Recent passport-size photograph, not older than 3 months, pasted on the form
Self-attested copies of mark sheets/certificates of 5th, 8th, 10th, 12th, graduation or other qualifications, as applicable
Certificate for age proof, and a certificate for age relaxation if claimed
Certificate of local residence of Bastar district, issued by the competent authority
OBC/SC/ST certificate, issued by the competent authority, if applicable
Certificate showing membership of a Naxal-victim family or a relief-camp family, if applicable
Assistant Constable, ex-serviceman or ex-Agniveer certificate, issued by the competent authority, if applicable
For Home Guards (Nagar Sainik), present or past: a service period certificate issued by the District Commandant, Home Guard
Third gender certificate, if applicable
Heavy motor vehicle driving licence, NCC-C or NSS-C certificate, if held
For government, semi-government or Chhattisgarh state, corporation or board employees (permanent or temporary): full details and a No Objection Certificate from the head of department
Aadhaar card number or Voter ID number

Full details, if the candidate was ever declared unfit for government service by a medical board, was arrested, prosecuted, fined or convicted in a criminal case, or has a case pending in a court, university or educational authority
The form also includes an acknowledgement slip (Pavti), which the receiving official signs with the date of receipt.

content_sections.heading: About Bastar Police Bastar Fighter Constable
content_sections.text: The Office of the Superintendent of Police at Jagdalpur heads the district police of Bastar, Chhattisgarh, and is conducting this recruitment. The Bastar Fighter Constable posts belong to the Chhattisgarh Police Special Executive Force (Bastar Fighters). The notice refers candidates to the Chhattisgarh Police and Bastar Police websites for the complete recruitment rules.

content_sections.heading: Bastar Police Bastar Fighter Constable Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 79 Bastar Fighter Constable posts are advertised for Bastar district. The State Government and Police Headquarters, Nava Raipur, may increase or decrease the number of posts and the pay scale, permanently or temporarily, through instructions issued from time to time. Ex-servicemen: 10% of the vacancies, as per government instructions. Women: 30% of the posts are filled by horizontal reservation from local women candidates of Bastar district, under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Special Provisions for Appointment of Women). Home Guards (Nagar Sainik): 25% horizontal reservation, as per government instructions. Assistant Constables: 15% horizontal reservation. Former Agniveers: 10% horizontal and category-wise reservation, under the Chhattisgarh Government letter dated 14.10.2026. The provisions of the Chhattisgarh Lok Seva (Reservation for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes), 1994, as named in the notice, apply in full. Instructions issued by the General Administration Department from time to time also apply.

content_sections.heading: Bastar Police Bastar Fighter Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Scheduled Tribe candidates are eligible even with a 5th class pass. Candidates of all categories may also apply with a 5th class pass if they belong to either of these groups: Naxal-victim families in the state. Families living in relief camps in Naxal-affected areas. Candidates must hold the prescribed qualification on the last date of application. Applicants are responsible for attaching their educational qualification certificates to the form. Only local residents of Bastar district may apply. Candidates of all categories must have a chest expansion of at least 5 cm. Women candidates are exempt from the chest requirement. The selection committee's decision on height and chest measurement is final. Third gender candidates must submit a certificate: If the certificate states male, the standards for men apply. If the certificate states female, the standards for women apply. The candidate must not be physically disabled. The candidate must not have knock-knee or flat-foot. This condition is compulsory for all posts. All candidates must be medically fit. The competent officer will decide on candidates found unfit for these reasons after examining them personally. The officer may consult the District Chief Medical Officer if needed. The candidate must not have any eye disease and must be able to distinguish the main colours. Candidates should check the full recruitment rules on the official websites for any further eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Bastar Fighter Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 79 vacancies: UR 16, OBC 11, SC 02 and ST 50.

faq.question: Q2. When do Bastar Fighter Constable applications start?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted from 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for the Bastar Fighter Constable application?
faq.answer: The last date is 12 December 2026, until 5:00 PM during office hours. Postal applications must reach the Superintendent of Police office, Jagdalpur, by then.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for Bastar Fighter Constable posts?
faq.answer: Only local residents of Bastar district can apply, subject to the age, qualification and physical standards in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Bastar Fighter Constable?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not less than 18 years and not more than 28 years of age as on 01.01.2026. SC, ST and Backward Class candidates get up to 5 years of relaxation, and local women of Bastar district get up to 10 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Bastar Fighter Constable?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 10th pass from a school in Chhattisgarh/Madhya Pradesh. ST candidates, and candidates of all categories from Naxal-victim families or relief-camp families, are eligible with a 5th class pass.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a Bastar Fighter Constable?
faq.answer: The post carries Level-4 of the pay matrix approved by the Government, plus allowances payable from time to time.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Bastar Fighter Constable?
faq.answer: Selection involves document verification, physical measurement, a 100-mark physical efficiency test, a 50-mark objective written exam and a 20-mark interview. Bonus marks of up to 30 are added, and the final merit list is based on the total.

faq.question: Q9. How are bonus marks given in Bastar Fighter Constable recruitment?
faq.answer: A heavy motor vehicle driving licence earns 5 marks, an NCC "C" or NSS "C" certificate earns 5 marks, and knowledge of the district's local dialect earns 20 marks. The certificates must be held on the last date of application.

faq.question: Q10. How do I submit the Bastar Fighter Constable application by post?
faq.answer: Send the form only by registered Indian Post to the Office of the Superintendent of Police, Jagdalpur, District Bastar, PIN 494001. Bring the postal receipt on the date fixed for recruitment.
